verdicts.why: The check establishes a successful import and one closure, then detects that subsequent upload, mapping, and confirmation attempts are refused as import_closed without changing stored state. It does not assert rooms, pointers, new customers, the closure digest, exactly one AuditEntry, or that all successful-import writes occurred in one transaction.
